title: Waiver or renunciation of claim or right after breach.
bodyText: A claim or right arising out of an alleged breach may be discharged in whole or in part without consideration by agreement of the aggrieved party in a signed record.
bodyHtml: §490:1-306  Waiver or renunciation of claim or right after breach.  A claim or right arising out of an alleged breach may be discharged in whole or in part without consideration by agreement of the aggrieved party in a signed record. [L 2004, c 162, pt of §1; am L 2023, c 132, §5]
